newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: ABB SAYS NOT IN TALKS WITH WESTINGHOUSE ON POWER.
newsitem.headline: ABB SAYS NOT IN TALKS WITH WESTINGHOUSE ON POWER.

text.p: Goran Lindahl, chief executive officer of ABB Asea Brown Boveri AG, said the electrical engineering group was not in discussions with Westinghouse Electric Corp over its power business.
"We are not in discussions with Westinghouse over their power business," Lindahl told Reuters in a telephone interview.
He noted ABB had tried to acquire Westinghouse's power business years ago, but the U.S. Justice Department had ruled against this for anti-trust reasons.
"We would have become too big in the U.S.," he said.
"We don't see that anything has changed," Lindahl added.
Earlier this week Franco-British joint venture GEC Alsthom said it was interested in Westinghouse's power business, but talks had not been started.
